feature: Fix Number Input Cursor Position Bug

phases.name: Fix Cursor Position in Number Inputs
phases.description: Add cursor position preservation to QuantityInput and MoneyInput components

subtasks.description: Fix QuantityInput cursor position by adding ref tracking and useEffect restoration
subtasks.notes: Added cursorPositionRef and inputRef with useImperativeHandle. Added useEffect to restore cursor position after sanitizedValue changes. Store cursor position in handleChange before processing value.

verification.run: Test in activity form - enter number, place cursor in middle, type - should insert at cursor position

subtasks.description: Fix MoneyInput cursor position restoration using useEffect with ref
subtasks.notes: Added cursorPositionRef to track cursor position during edits. Added inputRef with useImperativeHandle to properly expose input element. Added useEffect to restore cursor position after controlledValue changes. Store cursor position in handleChange before processing value. Changed Input ref from ref to inputRef.

verification.run: Test in bulk holdings form - enter currency amount, place cursor in middle, type - should insert at cursor position

issues_found.description: No critical or major issues found. Minor issue: No automated tests for cursor position behavior.
